description: Buy a pack of Aquedra Run credits (US$5, US$20, US$50, US$100; 1 credit = US$1), only when the user asked for it or authorized their wallet to spend. With method "card" the result has a checkout_url the person completes in their browser; this tool never charges a card. With method "usdc" and no payment, the result is an x402 payment request (isError, PaymentRequired in structuredContent); an x402 wallet pays by calling this tool again with the same arguments and the signed payment in params._meta["x402/payment"], and the result's _meta["x402/payment-response"] carries the settlement. If a result says a payment is pending, do not pay again: call again with the same payment.

method.description: card returns a checkout_url the person pays in their browser; usdc pays over x402.

pack_usd.description: Credit pack in US dollars; 1 credit = US$1.
